dependency_exceptions.reason: Universal Zoomify release lists KotlinLangForge as required for NeoForge. Fabric uses Fabric Language Kotlin. The Fabric descriptor does not require KotlinLangForge.

environment_exceptions.reason: Exact published Prickle Fabric artifact provides local JSON configuration, with empty mixin lists, no Minecraft networking registration or server lifecycle dependency. Enchantment Descriptions uses it only for local config. The asynchronous HTTP HEAD update check catches errors and does not gate functionality; it is not a companion-server protocol.

writing_glyph_audit.scope: Static glyph presence only. No font rendering, editor, client/server or launcher runtime test.

writing_input_audit.scope: Exact JAR bytecode and source inspection only; no Minecraft execution. KeyEvent.key/input is a physical SDL3 scancode. Paste consumes attempted text length even when vanilla insertion truncates or rejects it.
